notes: A node is a (left, right) tuple; a leaf is (None, None), built from variables so every node is a fresh allocation.
Reference counting frees a dropped tree node by node as soon as its root loses its last reference; freed 2-tuples are recycled through CPython's tuple free list.
Recursive build and check (depth ≤ 22, far below the recursion limit); the lines go out in one sys.stdout.writelines call.
